objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed artifact representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions, or other organizational content subject to creation, editing, approval, and distribution workflows.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: A document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: A document type describing company-wide or locally-defined regulations and instructions.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: A document type describing specific procedures, process sequences, and responsible persons to achieve objectives.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: A document type documenting detailed work steps and compliance criteria for sub-processes.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document automatically released with the main document and subject to its own versioning and release process.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and not requiring formal approval.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A request to amend an existing document without affecting its content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated workflow request to review and extend the validity period of a document reaching its expiration threshold.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a document that no longer has validity.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate and restore an archived and invalidated document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person in the system with assigned roles and permissions for document management activities.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users assigned with shared permissions and roles for document access and workflow participation.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups or persons designated to receive notification and access to a document upon release.

objs.name: document_version
objs.description: A specific release state of a document with associated metadata, content, and approval signatures.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported approval process guiding documents or requests through defined steps with participant sign-offs.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: A designated user group retaining read access to archived documents while other users lose permissions.

objs.name: organizationalunit
objs.description: A company division or business unit referenced in document scope and distribution.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: A software system referenced or linked to a document for context and implementation.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: System reference data such as organizational units, IT applications, or risks linked to documents.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: An organizational risk linked to a document for governance purposes.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Initiate a new document in the system by attaching a new information object with a selected document type and optional template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modify the text and content of a document using an integrated editing client.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Add or update standardized or customer-specific attributes and properties of a document.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Define user group and person-level permissions for reader, author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, and translator roles on a document.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: Add a controlled document to a main document that will be released with it.

evts.name: create_additional_information
evts.description: Add uncontrolled supplementary content to a document without triggering a new version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Submit a proposed amendment to an existing document for consideration by the author.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Apply an electronic signature as confirmation during a workflow step by an assigned participant.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Approve and publish a document to make it visible to authorized readers after successful workflow completion.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Check a document for technical and formal compliance during the review workflow step.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert a document from its source format to PDF for web display.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Make a released document available and visible to readers in the system.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an attachment as archived so it is removed from the current version but retained for historical access.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Create a new editing version of a released document to incorporate changes or updates.

evts.name: acknowledge_document
evts.description: Confirm receipt and understanding of a document by a user designated in the distribution list for acknowledgement.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Update the validity period of a document after a review confirms it remains current and appropriate.

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: Declare a document invalid and archive it when it no longer has validity or compliance relevance.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Restore the validity of an archived and invalidated document for continued use.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Create a language-dependent version of a released document for localized access by authorized readers.

evts.name: distribute_document_by_email
evts.description: Notify assigned users and user groups via email when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_validity_extension
evts.description: System process that automatically creates a validity extension request when a document approaches expiration.

evts.name: process_validity_extension_workflow
evts.description: Execute the workflow steps to review and approve the extension of a document's validity period.

evts.name: process_override_workflow
evts.description: Execute the workflow steps to review and approve the invalidation and archiving of a document.

evts.name: process_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: Execute the workflow steps to review and approve the restoration of an archived document.

evts.name: process_translation_workflow
evts.description: Execute the workflow steps to review and approve a translated version of a document.

evts.name: generate_report
evts.description: Produce role-specific evaluation reports and search results based on selected parameters and criteria.

A document has multiple versions across its lifecycle.
A document progresses through assigned workflows for approval and release.
A document specifies scope and validity for particular organizational units.
A document references or links to IT applications for implementation context.
A document addresses or links to organizational risks.
A document is automatically linked with master data such as processes and organizational structures.
A user is a member of one or more user groups.
A user group can be assigned to a distribution list.
Policy is a document type.
Guideline is a document type.
Procedural Instruction is a document type.
Work Instruction is a document type.
